topic: Someone finds their grandmother's engagement ring in a pawn shop
text: I can't believe I found it, just sitting there in a case, like it was nothing special. I recognized it straight away, that intricate design, the way the light catches the diamond—Grandma's engagement ring. I remember her hand, so gentle, showing it to me the first time, telling me how Grandpa got it when he couldn't afford much else. I’ve been searching for ages, ever since it went missing. It’s not just a piece of jewelry; it’s a piece of her. I have to get it back, no matter what. I’ll work extra shifts, sell things if I have to, but it has to come home with me. It just has to.
